interaction: FGF9 binds to FGFR3 on the receiver cell
signaling_pathway: Proposed FGFR3-associated signaling involving FRS2, GRB2, SOS1, and HRAS
expected_response: Potential changes in astrocyte maturation and function
evidence_source: Brandebura et al. (2022); Human Protein Atlas; OmniPath; STRING; IntAct
evidence_notes: The neuron-to-astrocyte FGF9 model is supported by literature and database annotations; the complete downstream pathway is proposed. IntAct BioID evidence indicates proximity between FGFR3 and FRS2, not necessarily direct binding.
